clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for large series hexagon, high strength structural steel nuts in property classes 8 and 10 and in the size range M16 to M36 suitable for use in both friction-type and bearing-type structural steel connections. Nuts to this standard when matched with the appropriate bolts have been designed to provide an assembly with a high level of assurance against failure by thread stripping on overtightening. Note - Attention is drawn to the importance of ensuring that the nuts are correctly used if satisfactory results are to be obtained.

clauses.title: Thread
clauses.text: 2.1 Thread  Sizes - M12, M16, M20, (M22), M24, (M27), M30 and M36 Note 1 - Sizes shown in brackets are of second preference Note 2 - For detailed dimensions refer  to Table 1 of the standard

clauses.title: Threads of the nuts
clauses.text: 2.2 Threads of the nuts shall be in a condance to IS 4218 [Parts (1, 2, 3 and 4)]

clauses.title: Grade – Unless other
clauses.text: 3. Grade -  Unless other wire specified the nuts shall be of product grade B as specified in IS  1367 (Part 2). The tolerances on the threads shall conform to tolerance 6H of IS 14962 [Part (1, 2 and 3) and in case of hot dip galramized with the tolerances shall be in accordance with IS 14962 [(Part 4 and 5)] *   Technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners (various parts) +   ISO metric Threads
